query: Single-phase fcc FeCoNi has high saturation magnetization but a low coercive field, and reported single-phase fcc high-entropy alloys derived from it have coercive fields no greater than 100 Oe in the reported magnetic measurements. What single intervention could overcome this coercivity limitation? Formulate one hypothesis specifying the intervention, its mechanism, the predicted change relative to single-phase fcc FeCoNi or a matched derivative, the relevant compositional, structural, and measurement boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a controlled experiment with an explicit falsification criterion.

generation.hypothesis: Introduction of a secondary phase with high magnetic anisotropy through controlled precipitation of a Co-rich phase within the fcc FeCoNi matrix.
generation.intervention: Heat treatment to induce precipitation of a Co-rich phase
generation.conditions: Temperature range 500-700°C, time 1-10 hours, under inert atmosphere
generation.structural_mediator: Precipitation of a Co-rich phase with high magnetic anisotropy
generation.mechanism: Introduction of magnetic anisotropy through the secondary phase, leading to increased coercive field
generation.predicted_outcome: Increase in coercive field by a factor of 5-10 relative to single-phase fcc FeCoNi
generation.baseline: Single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloy with coercive field < 100 Oe
generation.boundary: Compositional boundary: FeCoNi alloy with < 10% variation in composition; Structural boundary: fcc crystal structure with < 5% lattice strain; Measurement boundary: Magnetic measurements at room temperature
generation.uncertainty: Uncertainty in the precise composition and structure of the precipitated phase, and its effect on the overall magnetic properties

falsification_experiment.design: Controlled heat treatment of single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloy, followed by magnetic measurements
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the coercive field does not increase by a factor of 2 within the specified temperature and time range, the hypothesis is falsified
